final_classification_verbatim: BROKEN — A simpler alternative mechanism can plausibly reproduce the key predicted result and is not currently controlled.
final_classification_justification_short: The experiment as instrumented cannot produce a C > S' >= S result on transfer/hidden that the intended CVI interpretation would be justified from: (1) the causal contingency is confounded with 'being told you are wrong' (no non-contingent-verdict sham arm exists); (2) S' is a damaged/inert control, so C > S' is trivially explained by S''s incapacity; (3) the answers are no-feedback-derivable from the shared public examples; (4) baseline matching is broken (bimodal S0); (5) the retention metric M is algebraically undefined for C and can false-pass; (6) transfer saturates to ceiling and Family C re-tests the same templates. Any one of these is a plausible uncontrolled simpler mechanism for an apparent C > S' >= S pattern.

summary_facts.predicted_primary_outcome: C > S' >= S on S_tr and S_ver (design sections 1, 6)

observed_primary_outcome.S_tr: 1.000 for all arms (ceiling) in CVI-0 and CVI-0.1
observed_primary_outcome.S_ver: 0.250 for all arms in CVI-0.1 (0.750 in CVI-0)
observed_primary_outcome.S_ret: 0.250 for all arms = S0 in CVI-0.1 (no retention)
observed_primary_outcome.S_post: within-session only; C=0.75, S'=0.25 in CVI-0.1

summary_facts.note: Neither pilot produced C > S' >= S on the outcomes the CVI claim must move; the only separation is within-session S_post, which the design's own criterion #2 labels 'in-context patchwork'. The BROKEN classification targets the design's current capacity to support the intended interpretation in a future run, not a claim that CVI is false.
observed_evidence: Phase-0 baseline bytes/hashes identical across arms (hash-enforced, tests pass)
Feedback to C is PASS/FAIL + error class only; never output value or hidden material; all failures error_class=null
All-Family-A answers derivable from shared public examples (ce_no_feedback_solve.py: hidden_score 1.0 on all 4)
Verdict is a fixed string over the wrong-idiom class (ce_sham_verdict_redundant.py)
S' baseline correct (1.0) then fresh critique round-0 matched by value-discard idiom; rounds 1-3 byte-identical no-op
Transfer S_tr=1.0 for all arms; S solves S3 novel-composition rungs with zero interaction
Family C = Family A recipes/spec with fresh cases (generate_family_c calls generate_family_a)
S_ver = S0 = S_ret = 0.25; every arm emits identical wrong idiom at baseline/retention/hidden
No per-task token parity implemented; prompt-cache skews accounting
Retention metric M returns null for C and can false-pass (M=1.0) for a zero-learning arm
